name: Circular Mirror with Decoration of Concentric Circles, Linked Arcs, and Quatrefoil
summary: This circular bronze mirror has a wide, flat, unembellished rim that leads into a slightly sunken decorative band of short, radiating lines and concentric circles.  Within this decorative band are eight linked arcs in slight relief.  The linked arcs form an eight-pointed star that surrounds a ring and quatrefoil.
